title: 第13章 摆摊卖肉夹馍-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “那……那你打算在哪儿卖？”

    赵素梅的语气已经软了下来，她虽然担心，但她信自己的男人。

    “镇上有个农机厂，三百多号工人，中午都在厂里吃饭。

    厂里的食堂伙食差，很多工人不愿意吃，经常有人去外面买。

    我打听过了，厂门口那块地方没人管，摆个摊子就行。”

    “那你啥时候去？”

    “明天。”林国强站起来，“今天晚上我先把面发上，肉卤上，明天一早起来烙馍。”

    他说干就干。

    当天晚上，赵素梅带着两个孩子先睡了，林国强一个人在灶台边忙活。

    他把五花肉切成大块，焯水去腥，然后用冰糖炒糖色，把肉块放进去翻炒上色，加入酱油、料酒、八角、桂皮、香叶、生姜、大葱，最后倒上水，小火慢炖。

    灶膛里的火苗舔着锅底，锅里的肉汤咕嘟咕嘟地冒着泡，香味慢慢地弥散开来，填满了整间屋子。

    赵素梅在炕上翻了个身，迷迷糊糊地吸了吸鼻子：“好香……”

    林国强笑了笑，把火调小了些，盖上锅盖，让肉在锅里慢慢地焖着。

    然后他开始和面。

    白吉馍的面要硬，揉的时候得使劲。

    他把面粉倒进盆里，加入酵母粉和温水，一遍一遍地揉。

    直到面团光滑、有弹性，才盖上湿布，放在灶台边发酵。

    等这一切忙完，已经是半夜了。

    他洗了手，走到炕边，看了看熟睡的妻女。

    赵素梅的眉头在睡梦中舒展开了，不像以前那样总是皱着。

    林静把被子蹬开了，一条腿露在外面，小脚丫脏兮兮的。

    林薇趴着睡，屁股撅得老高，嘴角挂着一串口水。

    他轻轻地把林静的被子盖好，又把林薇翻了个个儿，然后躺在炕上，睁着眼睛看着天花板。

    天花板是新糊的报纸，上面有一篇关于“改革开放”的文章。

    标题很醒目——“让一部分人先富起来”。

    他盯着那行字看了很久。

    上一世，他是那部分“没富起来”的人。

    不是没机会，是机会来了他没抓住。

    他总是想着先帮别人，等帮完了别人，机会早没了。

    这一世，他不会再错过了。

    ……

    第二天凌晨四点半，林国强就起来了。
    第(1/3)页

“Then…then where do you plan to sell it?”

Zhao Sumei’s tone has softened. Although she is worried, she believes in her man.

“There is an agricultural machinery factory in the town, with more than 300 workers, and they all have lunch in the factory.

The food in the factory canteen is poor and many workers are unwilling to eat. Some often go out to buy food.

I have inquired about it, and no one cares about the area at the entrance of the factory. Just set up a stall."

"Then when are you going?"

"Tomorrow." Lin Guoqiang stood up, "Tonight I will make the noodles and braise the meat first, and then get up early tomorrow morning to bake the buns."

​​He just did it.

That night, Zhao Sumei took her two children to bed first, while Lin Guoqiang was busy at the stove alone.

He cut the pork belly into large pieces, blanched it in water to remove the fishy smell, then fried it with rock sugar until the color became brown, put the meat pieces in and stir-fried until it gets the color, added soy sauce, cooking wine, star anise, cinnamon, bay leaves, ginger, green onions, and finally poured in water and simmered over low heat.

The flames in the stove were licking the bottom of the pot, and the broth in the pot was bubbling. The aroma slowly spread and filled the whole room.

Zhao Sumei turned over on the kang and sniffed drowsily: "It smells so good..."

Lin Guoqiang smiled, turned down the heat, covered the pot, and let the meat simmer slowly in the pot.

Then he started making noodles.

The dough of Bai Ji Mo should be hard, so you have to knead it hard.

He poured the flour into a basin, added yeast powder and warm water, and kneaded it over and over again.

Until the dough is smooth and elastic, cover it with a damp cloth and place it on the stove to ferment.

By the time all this was done, it was already midnight.

He washed his hands, walked to the kang, and looked at his sleeping wife and daughter.

Zhao Sumei’s brows relaxed in her sleep, not frowning like before.

Lin Jing kicked off the quilt, one leg was exposed, and her little feet were dirty.

Lin Wei was sleeping on her stomach, with her butt stuck out high and a string of drool hanging from the corner of her mouth.

He gently covered Lin Jing's quilt, turned Lin Wei over, then lay on the kang, looking at the ceiling with his eyes open.

The ceiling is a fresh newspaper with an article about "reform and opening up".

The title is very eye-catching - "Let some people get rich first."

He stared at the line of words for a long time.

In his last life, he was one of those people who "didn't get rich".

It’s not that he didn’t have a chance, it’s that he didn’t seize the opportunity when it came.

He always thinks of helping others first, and by the time he finishes helping others, the opportunity will be gone.

In this life, he will not miss it again.

……

Lin Guoqiang got up at 4:30 in the morning the next day.
